llama-stack.description: Comprehensive AI orchestration platform that provides a unified API for multiple model providers, safety shields, and AI agent capabilities.
provides: Safety shields with Llama Guard and other safety models
AI agent capabilities with persistent memory
Automatic model discovery and URL generation

ogx-ai.description: Successor chart providing orchestration with OpenAI-compatible APIs, multi-provider model support, and MCP-style tool integration.
provides: AI agent capabilities with persistent memory
Automatic model discovery and URL generation
ogx-ai.use_when: Agentic orchestration with OpenAI compatibility needed

llm-service.description: High-performance model serving using vLLM runtime with OpenShift AI/KServe integration supporting GPU and CPU deployment modes.
provides: vLLM-based model serving with OpenAI-compatible API
Support for any vLLM-compatible models and sizes
Tool calling and function execution support

pgvector.description: PostgreSQL with pgvector extension enabling high-performance vector database capabilities for embeddings in AI/ML applications.
provides: Vector similarity search (cosine, L2, inner product)
pgvector.use_when: Vector database for RAG/semantic retrieval needed

minio.description: S3-compatible object storage server for documents, models, and data in AI/ML pipelines with scalable storage and web console management.

oracle-db.description: Oracle Database Free 23ai with AI Vector features providing enterprise-grade database capabilities with built-in vector operations.
provides: Native vector operations and similarity search
TPC-DS automated data population via Kubernetes Job
Configurable scale factors and schema management
Automated security configuration for AI MCP server integration
oracle-db.use_when: Enterprise database with AI vector features needed

ingestion-pipeline.description: Comprehensive data ingestion pipeline processing documents from various sources and storing vector embeddings for semantic search and RAG.
ingestion-pipeline.use_when: Automated document ingestion and embedding pipeline needed

configure-pipeline.description: Jupyter notebook environment for RAG configuration and pipeline setup with interactive tools and MinIO integration for data access.
configure-pipeline.use_when: Interactive RAG configuration and pipeline setup needed

mcp-servers.description: Model Context Protocol servers providing external tools and capabilities to AI models for interacting with external systems and APIs.
provides: Integration with LlamaStack and OGX agents
mcp-servers.use_when: External tools and capabilities for AI agents needed

oracle-sqlcl.description: MCP server exposing Oracle SQLcl capabilities to AI agents via Toolhive, enabling database tooling and interactions from AI platforms.
provides: Execute SQL/PLSQL against Oracle databases via Model Context Protocol
Integrates with Toolhive Operator (CRDs and operator managed as chart dependencies)
Oracle connection managed via Kubernetes secrets and configurable service
oracle-sqlcl.use_when: Oracle database tooling for AI agents needed

keycloak.description: Identity and access management solution providing authentication and authorization for AI applications via OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and SAML.
provides: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and SAML protocols
Built-in PostgreSQL database (via pgvector subchart) or external database support
OpenShift Routes and Kubernetes Ingress support
Production-ready configuration with health checks and metrics
keycloak.use_when: Identity and access management for AI applications needed
